Name: Perfumed Candles for Bees Plus
Author: Ex0dus
Description:
[b][size=4]Description:[/size][/b]
[b] [/b]
[size=3]I originally created a version of this mod for Murmur of Bees but I had a request to make a version for Bees Plus, so with permission from the authors, I went ahead and did so![/size]

[size=3]This mod adds a machine (the Candle Station) that unlocks at Farming level 7. The Candle Station turns perfumes from the perfumery into candles using beeswax. By default this version of the mod uses the Beeswax directly from Bees Plus but there is also an option to convert that Beeswax into pure beeswax in the cooking menu so that players have the choice to make multiple candles worth of beeswax from a single harvested beeswax without otherwise affecting the Bees Plus mod.[/size]

[size=3]A version for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37426]Murmur of Bees [/url]can be found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52525]here[/url][/size]


[size=4][b]Main features:[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][size=3](Optional) Configurable amount of pure beeswax made when cooking beeswax in the cooking menu[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]5 candles that correspond to the 5 types of perfume made by the Perfumery mod[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Candle prices increase when the special order added by the Perfumery mod is completed[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]More valuable perfumes do not necessarily make the most profitable candles (though all candles are profitable). This gives lesser perfumes some later game use.[/size][/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Candle Rankings:[/size][/b]
[spoiler][size=3]1. Romantic
2. Mystic
3. Cozy
4. Brisk
5. Rustic[/size][/spoiler]

[b][size=4]Future Plans:[/size][/b]

[list]
[*][size=3]Specific Gift Tastes[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Crossover items with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49743]Chocobo Valley Remixed[/url][/size][/*]
[/list][size=4]
[b]Requirements:[/b][/size]

[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30597]Bees Plus[/url][/size]
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36832]Perfumery[/url][/size]

[b][size=4]Installation Instructions:[/size][/b]

[size=3]Download the Perfumed Candles Bees Plus file in the main files section, then install like normal[/size]

[size=3]Be sure you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30597]Bees Plus[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36832]Perfumery[/url] and their requirements installed first, otherwise this mod will do nothing.[/size]
